newsitem.title: USA: Harvard to show data on impotence product.
newsitem.headline: Harvard to show data on impotence product.

text.p: Harvard Scientific Corp said it will present results of its Phase I clinical trial for its treatment for male impotence at the American Urology Association meeting in New Orleans on April 14.

The company also said it had a "productive" meeting with the FDA, which recommended some minor adjustments to its upcoming Phase II trial. The trial will look at Harvard Scientific's lyophilized liposomal prostaglandin E1 product for the treatment of male erectile dysfunction.
